items.problem: `routing.bodyReadTimeoutMs` has no written range, so 0 is allowed (skills/core/SKILL.md:134), while body reads are measured with `network_time_limit`, which throws below 1 (skills/server-core/modules/server-time.md:39, skills/server-core/modules/server-time.md:89). With value 0, step 2 of the request processing order (routing.md:109) and the body step of `POST /account/deletion` (skills/server-core/modules/auth.md:298, read through auth.md:410) reach a throw, not the `INVALID_REQUEST` or 400 that those steps set

The spec says "the n-th value from the right of `X-Forwarded-For`" but does not set how that value is taken from the header. It does not say whether whitespace around `,` is trimmed (the usual form is `a, b`), or what the client IP is when the value is not a bare IP address (e.g. `unknown`, `203.0.113.5:4711`, `[2001:db8::1]`). Implementations can differ in the IP counter `target`, the `ip_in_cidrs` result of admin-api and cheat, and the truncated IP. This was there before the diff, which only adds the IPv4-mapped rule
